It is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh-Yanam coast between Nellore and Visakhapatnam around noon on 20 November, with winds of 100-110 km/h gusting to 120 km/h; earlier bulletins had expected a very severe cyclonic storm with winds of 145 km/h.
